# Subprocessor list

Vendors that process customer data on our behalf: one hosting provider, one email delivery provider and one payments processor. Contact details are in [vendor contacts](../references/vendor-contacts.md). Retention terms: [data retention](data-retention.md). Terms: [terms](../glossary/terms.md).

## Review
Reviewed with every vendor review ([vendor review](../processes/vendor-review.md)).
